question: Jack starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 3 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 2 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Jack starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards South.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 3 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 2 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P.
